name: artizen-api
description: ARTIZEN — backend API (FastAPI). T3 topology: the Flutter Web frontend is a separate static deploy (object storage + CDN), not part of this app.

PROJECT_DIR.description: Monorepo: build from the backend/ subdirectory (Dockerfile deploy).

SECRET_KEY.description: JWT signing key. Generate one (python -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(64))"); must be >= 32 chars and never the .env.example placeholder — the app refuses to boot otherwise.

DATABASE_URL_OVERRIDE.description: Set to the managed Postgres addon URL ($SCALINGO_POSTGRESQL_URL).

APP_BASE_URL.description: Public web-app URL, e.g. https://app.artizen.fr (used in email links).

RETENTION_INACTIVE_ACCOUNT_DAYS.description: Optional. Left unset = retention purge disabled (no-op) until the legal policy fixes a duration.
